# Mugisha AI

> Mugisha AI (legal name Mugisha Marketing, CVR 42773786) is an AI automation agency in Copenhagen, Denmark. We build AI agents and automations, run AI audits with a roadmap, and build custom software and websites for businesses of about 10 to 500 staff. The site is in English and Danish.

## English
- [Home](https://mugishamarketing.com/): what we do and who we help
- [Services](https://mugishamarketing.com/services/): AI agents and automations, AI audit, custom software, web development
- [AI consultant](https://mugishamarketing.com/ai-consultant/): advice on where AI fits your business and what to do first
- [AI automation](https://mugishamarketing.com/ai-automation/): workflows that move work and data between your systems
- [AI agents](https://mugishamarketing.com/ai-agents/): AI that handles one narrow job with limits and a person in the loop
- [AI implementation](https://mugishamarketing.com/ai-implementation/): taking a chosen AI solution from plan to daily use
- [AI chatbot](https://mugishamarketing.com/ai-chatbot/): a website chatbot that answers from your own material
- [AI guides](https://mugishamarketing.com/guides/): hub listing every guide
- [What is agentic AI](https://mugishamarketing.com/guides/what-is-agentic-ai/): definition, comparison with chatbots and automation, examples, safety and EU rules
- [n8n vs Make vs Zapier](https://mugishamarketing.com/guides/n8n-vs-make-vs-zapier/): hosting, pricing model, AI features and data location compared
- [About](https://mugishamarketing.com/about/): how the company began and how we work
- [Contact](https://mugishamarketing.com/contact/): the contact form
- [Privacy policy](https://mugishamarketing.com/privacy-policy/): how we handle personal data
- [Terms of service](https://mugishamarketing.com/terms-of-service/): terms for our work

## Dansk
- [Forside](https://mugishamarketing.com/da/): AI-bureau i København
- [Ydelser](https://mugishamarketing.com/da/ydelser/): AI-automatisering, AI-agenter, AI-implementering, AI-rådgivning
- [AI-konsulent](https://mugishamarketing.com/da/ai-konsulent/): rådgivning om, hvor AI passer i din virksomhed, og hvad du gør først
- [AI-automatisering](https://mugishamarketing.com/da/ai-automatisering/): arbejdsgange, der flytter arbejde og data mellem dine systemer
- [AI-agenter](https://mugishamarketing.com/da/ai-agenter/): AI, der tager en afgrænset opgave med grænser og et menneske i løkken
- [AI-implementering](https://mugishamarketing.com/da/ai-implementering/): fra plan til daglig brug af en valgt AI-løsning
- [AI-chatbot](https://mugishamarketing.com/da/ai-chatbot/): en chatbot på hjemmesiden, der svarer ud fra dit eget materiale
- [Viden om AI](https://mugishamarketing.com/da/viden/): oversigt over alle guides
- [Hvad er agentisk AI](https://mugishamarketing.com/da/viden/hvad-er-agentisk-ai/): definition, forskel på chatbot og automatisering, eksempler, sikkerhed og EU-regler
- [n8n, Make eller Zapier](https://mugishamarketing.com/da/viden/n8n-make-eller-zapier/): hosting, prismodel, AI-funktioner og placering af data sammenlignet
- [Om os](https://mugishamarketing.com/da/om-os/): hvordan firmaet blev til, og hvordan vi arbejder
- [Kontakt](https://mugishamarketing.com/da/kontakt/): kontaktformularen
- [Privatlivspolitik](https://mugishamarketing.com/da/privatlivspolitik/): sådan behandler vi personoplysninger
- [Handelsbetingelser](https://mugishamarketing.com/da/handelsbetingelser/): vilkår for vores arbejde
